nodes.label: Phase 1 Slice 2 Handoff
nodes.rationale: All 14 tasks landed. Exit run against 150 real STLs rather than the six repository fixtures, because the fixtures drain in about 70 ms — not long enough to kill a worker mid-scan with any reliability. SIGKILL at 52 done / 4 running / 94 pending came back as 150 ingested, 0 failed.

nodes.label: Reachable, Not Merely Up
nodes.rationale: Seven tests failed with PoolTimedOut while podman ps said 'Up 2 hours' and in-container pg_isready reported accepting connections: the rootless port forwarder had died while the container stayed healthy internally. docker ps and an in-container pg_isready answer the same wrong question. Use a host-side TCP connect — 'container up' and 'container reachable' are different claims and only the second is the one the tests depend on.

nodes.label: One Implementer per Worktree
nodes.rationale: Two tasks died mid-flight with their work intermingled and uncommitted in one tree. They were separated by inspection of which file belonged to which task, not by guessing, and committed separately so history stays honest. Note also that git commit commits the whole index, not just what one agent added.
